items.title: War in Ukraine now longer than WWI: Russia's full scale invasion reached 1,569 days
items.description: 1,569 days – four years and three months: That is how long Russia's war in Ukraine has lasted. It is a milestone, surpassing the duration of World War One. The two conflicts are often compared for their brutal infantry assaults and heavy casualties. For more, FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg reports from Kyiv, Ukraine.

items.title: Hours After Trump Warning, US Resumes Air Strikes On Iran
items.description: US armed forces launched a second night of air strikes on Iran late on June 10, just hours after President Donald Trump warned Tehran it would be hit "very hard" if a deal aimed at ending more than three months of war is not finalized.

items.title: In the Ukraine war, new ground-based drones are playing a key role on the battlefield
items.description: Ukraine relies on robotic warfare to punch above its weight on the battlefield, including shifting frontline duties from soldiers to land drones.

items.title: Nearly 1,000 dead in Gaza since start of ceasefire illusion
items.description: The deal brokered by Donald Trump in October 2025 promised an immediate end to hostilities and unlimited humanitarian aid. In the eight months since then, the Gaza Strip has plunged further into a humanitarian crisis, claiming its victims every day.

items.title: Why is Hezbollah still important for Iran?
items.description: Although weakened, the Lebanon-based Hezbollah militant group remains a central piece of Iran's power projection in the Middle East. Tehran has insisted they be included in any peace deal with the US and Israel.

items.title: Syria flips the script. It’s an island of calm in the stormy Middle East.
items.description: Decades of dictatorship culminated in 15 years of war and turmoil in Syria. But with the U.S.-Iran war, a relatively peaceful Syria is now an outpost of progress and hope in the Middle East.
